verdict.rationale: Flagright's Management API covers the core of two-way case sync for a developer. It can create cases, list them with status filters, and post status changes (including custom statuses). It also exposes alerts and alert hits with OPEN/CLEARED/ESCALATED states. Signed, retried webhooks can push events outward, though only SAR events are shown explicitly. Missing for 10: documented webhook events for case/alert status changes, sync of investigation notes/comments/evidence, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of an integration with an external case-management system.
